name: sevenfriends
author: Leif Auke <leif@auke.no> (Blueboot R&D AS)
description: Seven Friends: stay in touch with your seven closest friends

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix functions install
scripts.dev:emulators: node scripts/with-java.mjs firebase emulators:start --only auth,functions,firestore,storage --project demo-sevenfriends --import=.emulator-data --export-on-exit=.emulator-data
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix functions run build
scripts.test:emulator: node scripts/with-java.mjs firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.test.json --only firestore --project demo-sevenfriends-test "npm --prefix functions run test:run"
scripts.android:sync: node scripts/sync-android-sounds.mjs && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix frontend exec cap -- sync android
scripts.ios:sync: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix frontend exec cap -- sync ios
scripts.ios:open: npm --prefix frontend exec cap -- open ios
scripts.android:open: node scripts/sync-android-sounds.mjs && npm --prefix frontend exec cap -- open android
